MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water always increases oxygen
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

5. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Primary consumers only

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Production Systems? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Production Systems.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Production Systems.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Production Systems.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Production Systems.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL.

9. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Ice melting to water

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. A chemical reaction forming ash
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Pond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
